data.name: Magical Knack
data.description: You were raised, either wholly or in part, by a magical creature, either after it found you abandoned in the woods or because your parents often left you in the care of a magical minion. This constant exposure to magic has made its mysteries easy for you to understand, even when you turn your mind to other devotions and tasks. Your caster level in %1 gains a +2 trait bonus as long as this bonus doesn't raise your caster level above your current Hit Dice.|%LIST
